author: blu
body: Proves the reveal / hand-disruption ability. Duress reads "Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a noncreature card from it. That player discards that card." It compiles, via the multi-effect splitter, to a RevealHand marker plus a discard: the opponent loses a card, and the RevealHand effect records that the caster legitimately saw the opponent's hand (the observation the AI belief model will consume once wired in). Here we prove the mechanical effect -- the opponent's hand shrinks -- and that the RevealHand marker is present in the card's IR.
